Summary GDPR Privacy Notice: Data is processed for intake, diagnosis, quote, repair, delivery, operational communications, and legal obligations. Customers may exercise their GDPR rights and lodge a complaint with the Data Protection Authority.
The customer authorizes the intake, custody, and technical diagnosis of the object. Any repair with an estimated cost is performed only after customer confirmation.

Summary Privacy Notice pursuant to EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR).
Data Controller: {{proprietario_nome}}, {{proprietario_piva}}, {{proprietario_indirizzo}}, contactable at the point of sale or via: {{proprietario_email}} {{proprietario_telefono}}.
Purposes: Management of repair orders, technical diagnosis, quoting, repair execution, delivery, post-intervention assistance, operational communications, and accounting/tax compliance.
Legal bases: Execution of pre-contractual or contractual measures, compliance with legal obligations, and legitimate interest in organizational management. For non-essential communications (e.g. via WhatsApp), specific consent is required and granted by the customer by providing the contact number.
Processed data: Identification and contact details, tax information, device info, problem description, photos, signatures, and history.
Retention: Data is retained for the period necessary to manage the repair order and subsequently as required for legal compliance or protection of rights.
Recipients: Authorized personnel, strictly necessary technical service providers, and legal authorities.
Rights: You have the right to access, rectify, or erase your data, as well as the right to restriction, objection, portability, and to lodge a complaint with the Data Protection Authority.

Service Intake Terms and Conditions.
The customer delivers the object specified in the repair order and authorizes {{proprietario_nome}} to store, inspect, and perform a technical diagnosis.
Diagnosis may require opening the device, testing, or connection to compatible power supplies. Repair work is initiated only after customer acceptance of the quote.
{{proprietario_nome}} is not liable for data loss, uncommunicated passwords, pre-existing defects, or inevitable deterioration emerging during diagnosis on already damaged objects. It is the customer's responsibility to back up data before delivery.
Quoted amounts must be accepted by the customer before work begins. In the event of rejection or failure to collect the device within 90 days, the object may be handled according to current regulations on abandoned property.
By signing, the customer confirms having read and accepted the privacy notice and these terms.

OnlyTechTake is a local-first management software for job orders and technical documentation. All your data stays on the device to guarantee maximum privacy and speed.
This application uses the following libraries: SQLCipher for encryption, Room for local database, Jetpack Compose for the UI, and Zip4j for backups.
